about_the_game:
Dome-King Cabbage is an award-winning visual novel about a cloud-person named Mush nervously making their way to a job interview. Mush has to grapple with their ability to perceive the world through the lens of a monster-collecting RPG.

What Kind of Game Is It, Exactly?

Dome-King Cabbage is a visual novel first and foremost. It deftly weaves between evocative prose, psychedelic animated shorts, dynamic manga pages, and even has a brief RPG section. It’s something that truly needs to be experienced to be understood.

An Adventure Awaits

Journey to the enigmatic Crumb Island with Mush and speak to various monsters, uncovering the obscured mysteries of the world and what it means to be a Dome-King.

Welcome to Crumb Island

Navigate your way through the island in search of The Interviewer, and experience the splintered memories of Mush and the creatures they meet along the way.

A Visual Novel With a Twist

Experience a visual novel with a unique dynamism that hasn’t been seen before. It’s a densely animated collage of eye-watering visuals set to skittering, genre-defying beats. Playing Dome-King Cabbage is like looking into a distorted memory of a lost monster-collecting RPG.
detailed_description:
BUZZ

“Cobysoft Co.’s monster-collecting visual novel is a glimpse into a gorgeous, chimerical 3D world inspired by ‘90s game box clay dioramas – but made purely with software.” - Edge

“..I’m still not fully sure what this game is, but I know that I’m really, really into it.” – IGN

“There’s nothing else out there that looks like Dome-King Cabbage, and it’s everything I want.” - Kotaku
